decisions.reason: As a sensor module close to the core modular platform, it likely has low carrying cost and still retains option value because there is no sign yet that market uncertainty has resolved negatively.
This module builds directly on the established industrial offer and its dedicated product page suggests stronger commitment, so keeping the option open is more attractive than withdrawing it.
A solid state relay module fits the firm's existing automation building blocks, making it relatively inexpensive to support while demand information is still developing.

The server room monitoring kit is somewhat more solution-specific than the core modules, so it faces a higher withdrawal risk, but it still leverages the firm's platform and remains worth keeping while prospects are uncertain.
